ticker_news.title: Prediction: These 2 AI Stocks Will Be the Biggest Winners From $1.4 Trillion Infrastructure Spending
ticker_news.description: With AI infrastructure spending projected to reach $1.4 trillion in 2026, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC) and Alphabet are positioned as major beneficiaries. TSMC, as the primary chip manufacturer for AI data centers, is expected to achieve 30% revenue growth and potentially higher earnings growth due to chip price increases. Alphabet is gaining traction with its custom TPUs, securing major deals with Anthropic and potentially Meta, which could significantly boost its revenue and earnings.
ticker_news.author: Harsh Chauhan

ticker_news.title: 1 Beaten-Down AI Stock to Buy and Hold Forever
ticker_news.description: Meta Platforms is presented as an undervalued AI stock opportunity despite recent market underperformance. The company's strong social media ecosystem with 3.5 billion daily active users, combined with AI-powered advertising improvements, positions it well for growth. While concerns exist about massive AI spending and potential margin pressure, Meta's ability to pivot strategy and its lowest forward P/E ratio among Magnificent Seven peers make it attractive for long-term investors.
ticker_news.author: Prosper Junior Bakiny

ticker_news.title: AI Assistants Head into 2026 on a High Note: Comscore Reports Triple-Digit Growth on Mobile
ticker_news.description: Comscore reports that mobile visitation to AI assistant destinations reached 54.3M unique visitors in December 2025, up 107% YoY, with desktop reaching 83.0M (+18% YoY). ChatGPT leads on both platforms, while Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity show triple-digit growth rates on mobile. The data highlights mobile as the accelerating access point for AI assistants.
ticker_news.author: Comscore

ticker_news.title: Should You Forget BigBear.ai and Buy These 2 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks Instead?
ticker_news.description: The article advises investors to avoid BigBear.ai due to declining revenue, lack of profitability, and high valuation, recommending Micron Technology and Alphabet as superior AI stock alternatives. Micron benefits from surging demand for memory chips in AI data centers with strong revenue and earnings growth, while Alphabet's Gemini chatbot is gaining adoption with 650 million monthly active users and a lucrative partnership with Apple.
ticker_news.author: Chris Neiger

ticker_news.title: Streaming Media Device Market to Reach $182.12 Billion by 2030 Amid AI Integration
ticker_news.description: The streaming media device market is projected to grow from $80.59 billion in 2025 to $94.25 billion in 2026 (16.9% CAGR), reaching $182.12 billion by 2030 (17.9% CAGR). Growth drivers include 5G connectivity expansion, subscription-based streaming adoption, AI integration, and increased smart TV penetration. Tariff-driven localization of production is supporting market resilience.
ticker_news.author: Researchandmarkets.Com
